name: merged-screenshot-evidence
goal: Keep source-identical merged screenshots visible with honest original provenance and verify main after landing

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Main 0816efe and parent 27763e8 have zero attached records or focused captures. PR20 proof belongs to 4843a73b and is not in prepared main history; PR31 handoff accepted empty thumbnails. Squash landing creates a distinct commit despite an identical source tree.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Existing standardized loop/history tests rebuild only the feature fix commit. Add a source-identical sibling squash revision and a changed-tree rejection; extend the shared evidence selection suite to assert retained origin without a current/full-verification verdict.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Immutable red checkpoint at d3ac9bd7bbf7aef240ed23047ec9b02fe427425c fails source-identical squash in the existing loop/history matrix; separate UI selection run also rejects the same-tree image. Original main screenshot has zero page preview images.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Resolve sealed focused proof for identical complete Git trees, preserve original commit/build and focused status, reject changed trees, capture details routes through existing browser cases, and verify the actual merged history before handoff.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Git-backed history now reuses sealed focused captures only across identical complete source trees; shared UI retains original provenance, projections retain tree identity, and generated/local guidance requires post-merge preview decoding.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
